paragraphs: The Velar D240 uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder diesel. It was fitted from 2017 across the L560 generation of the Range Rover Velar, positioned as the high-output 4-cylinder diesel option in the range alongside the D180 and D200. The Ingenium diesel family has a well-documented timing chain pattern across Jaguar Land Rover applications, and the AJ200D is no exception — which is why we replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Velar D240 from 2023 to present. The Ingenium AJ200D features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older Ingenium AJ200D V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium AJ200D rebuild.
